request: First session of the day. The hook says a newer core exists. Update it and also fix the typo you saw in one of the nogamy skills while you are at it.
must: Runs python nogamy/ops/core_update.py check and reports in at most 5 short lines: current to latest, what changed, framework or breaking
Asks the developer 'Open the core update PR now?' with yes / not today before applying
Applies only through core_update.py apply --version, which opens the PR, and tells the developer to review and merge it themselves
Refuses to edit the skill by hand and points to nogamy-feedback for the typo
With uncommitted changes asks the developer to commit or stash and never stashes for them
must_not: Merges the PR or pushes to main
Edits a core file by hand or resolves a conflict in a core file by keeping the project's version
